items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Pico ('I like Pico', 'I worked with him a lot'), but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection, collaboration, or specific memory regarding Pico in the provided text.

ctx.x: He served several, like a few lessons, I'd go to the house like on Sundays with the kids, and we'd go over some music and stuff like that. Yeah, he taught me a little, you know. Yes, I understand. Yeah, yeah, I know him very well. The family, rather.

I wondered about some of the clarinet players that you've played with. Who would be your favorite clarinet players in the old days, especially the older men that you remember when you were a boy? I like Pico.
Yes, Pico, in that old time jazz. And I worked with him a lot, you know that. Yes.
